artworks.title: Oui, Monsieur, votre air respectable m'enhardit...
artworks.description: The image shows two men engaged in conversation. The man on the left has a narrow face with pronounced features, a prominent nose, and a few lines suggesting a stern expression. His hair is short and fits under his top hat. He is wearing a dark jacket with a waistcoat underneath, and a high-collared shirt with a cravat. He is gesturing while he speaks. The man on the right has a fuller face with a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. His hair is a bit longer and peeks out from underneath his top hat. He wears similar attire with a dark waistcoat and a knotted scarf. He holds a cane or walking stick. The background is plain, with light shading, and there is text in French beneath the image.

artworks.title: Regrets
artworks.description: The image depicts a man leaning on a windowsill with his elbows. The man has a distinct profile with a prominent nose and wears a dark cap. He is wearing a loose-fitting, striped long-sleeve shirt. A potted plant sits on the windowsill next to him. Outside the window, a woman wearing a full skirt and bonnet is seen walking along a path in a landscape with cloudy skies and flying birds. The image has a grayscale color scheme.

artworks.title: Douze ans et demi et trois premiers prix
artworks.description: The image shows three people. The leftmost person is slightly leaning back and wearing a tall black top hat and a dark coat. The middle individual is holding an open umbrella, tilted to the right. The person on the right is a child seen in profile, wearing a bowler hat and a suit with a bow tie, carrying a wreath or decorative object. The background features several tall building facades under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Un cauchemar de M. Bismarck
artworks.description: The image shows a man reclining on a cushioned surface. He has a moustache and a distressed expression, with his eyes closed and eyebrows furrowed. The man is bald, wearing a dark suit and white shirt. A skeletal Grim Reaper figure looms over him, holding a scythe. The background displays a desolate landscape.

artworks.title: La Partie de volant
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an allegorical scene featuring two figures labeled as "Guerre" and "Paix". The image shows the figure labeled "Guerre" on the left hitting a shuttlecock labeled "Europe" with a racket, while "Paix" on the right is prepared to receive it with another racket. Both figures wear flowing garments and "Guerre" holds a spear, while "Paix" carries an olive branch. Above the center shuttlecock is the word "Europe". The style of the drawing is reminiscent of 19th-century satirical caricature, emphasizing political allegory and the tension between war and peace over the future of Europe.

artworks.title: La Nouvelle Cendrillon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a figure wearing a dress labeled "AUTRICHE" and holding a shoe, with a hooded figure and a boot shape labeled "ITALIE" in the background. The drawing is in black and white with strong lines and shaded areas. The style is reminiscent of the satirical works of Honoré Daumier. The fleeing figure's exaggerated facial and bodily features suggest caricature. The background suggests movement and action.

artworks.title: L'éclipse sera-t-elle totale?
artworks.description: The image shows a series of linear rays emanating from a central point on the right side, creating an abstract burst effect across the composition. In the lower section, there is a circular shape representing a globe with the word "EUROPE" inscribed on it. Above, a silhouetted figure with a pointed hat emerges from the shadow, with the word "LIBERTÉ" encircled above it.

artworks.title: Adoremus!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures surrounding an urn labeled "URNE ÉLECTORALE." The figures are kneeling and raising their arms towards the urn. Radiating lines emerge from the urn, and the text "Adoremus!" is included in the drawing. The style is reminiscent of political cartoon art.

artworks.title: Gare la lumière!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several owls with human-like qualities reacting dramatically to a lantern inscribed with "LIBERTÉ ÉLECTORALE." The owls have exaggerated expressions of shock, fear, or surprise, as they flutter around with wide eyes and prominent wings. The scene focuses on the dichotomy between the light of the lantern and the owls' reactions. Various numbers "5C" are written throughout the piece. The artwork is rendered in a black and white illustrative style typical of political or social satire in period publications.

artworks.title: Pardon mon cher...
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an interaction between two figures with a symbolic theme. The scene shows a confrontation between a robed figure labeled "LIBERTÉ" and a distressed, muscular figure. The robed figure's hand is raised towards the other figure's face. In the background, there are round objects resembling cannonballs. The line work is bold and expressive, capturing the intensity of the moment. The gown of the figure labeled "LIBERTÉ" drapes elegantly. The scene likely conveys themes of power, freedom, and conflict.

artworks.title: Madame Gargantua
artworks.description: The image shows a woman leaning forward to take a bite from a large food item. She has exaggerated facial features, curly hair, and is dressed in a scoop-necked dress. She holds a wine glass in her left hand and the table in front of her is covered with foods and a tablecloth. In the background, three figures in cloaks and top hats are walking near an arched structure. The illustration is detailed with crosshatching for depth.

artworks.title: A l'instar de Pantin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a helmeted figure holding a marionette-like creature in a barren landscape under a cloudy sky. The helmeted figure has a strong posture and is exerting control over the contorted creature. The landscape has a rugged texture and a faint moon is visible in the sky. Objects on the ground have inscriptions. The drawing conveys drama and intensity, with the creature's contorted form contrasting against the background.

artworks.title: Ou Venise commence a espérer
artworks.description: The image features three figures in a sketched illustration. On the left, a robed figure holds a staff or oar, with one hand pulling back their hood slightly. The central figure wears a jacket and pants, gesturing towards a barefoot figure in minimal clothing. The background is plain, with text above indicating it is part of a publication or illustration series.

artworks.title: L'empire c'est la paix
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape of destruction from a slightly elevated angle. Dark, jagged remnants of debris or ruins are seen in the foreground. Further back, a structure with a doorway is visible amidst piles of lighter-colored debris. The horizon is covered by thick, swirling black smoke, with a few birds in flight faintly visible in the sky above. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray accentuating the somber impression of the scene.

artworks.title: Doucement!
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a character depicting European budgets, portrayed as a large, inflated figure perched on a tightrope. The character is embellished with sashes displaying various significant numerical values and the words "BUDGETS EUROPÉENS" above. The figure's exaggerated size and attire give a sense of bulkiness, emphasizing the precariousness of its position on the tightrope. The tightrope is illustrated above a simple platform, indicating tension and imbalance. The image appears to offer a satirical reflection on financial uncertainty or intricacies related to European budgets, created in a style reminiscent of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Le défenseur de Calas consolé...
artworks.description: The sculpture depicted in the illustration is of Voltaire. The sculpture represents an older man with a thin, elongated face and a pronounced nose, dressed in flowing robes. It is depicted in a monochrome scheme, suggesting the use of stone or a similar material. The figure leans forward slightly, with hands emerging from the long sleeves. The sculpture pedestal is set above a scene of tumultuous activity, with a guillotine in the background, showing a significant size difference and perspective.

artworks.title: La hache qui le coupera n'est pas encore trempée
artworks.description: This is an image of a jester standing beside a large tree with an axe nearby. The tree has the words "SUFFRAGE UNIVERSEL" carved into its trunk. The jester is holding a chisel and looking at the inscription, while an axe is placed on the ground next to the tree. The drawing is detailed, showing textures in the tree bark and jester's clothing.

artworks.title: Regardez, mais n'y touchez pas!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of caricatured figures. The central figure in the foreground is wearing an oversized top hat and formal attire while holding a flag. The face is heavily exaggerated and distorted, giving a comical appearance. In the background, there is a crowd of similarly styled figures, each characterized by distinct head shapes and large top hats, marching in line. The flags they carry are decorated with what appear to be fleur-de-lis symbols. The drawing uses heavy shading and line work.

artworks.title: Les écuries d'Augias
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a muscular figure holding a club, surrounded by waves and labeled currents. The central figure is depicted as strong and commanding, dressed in minimal clothing. They hold a large club in one hand and a cloth in the other. The background features swirling water-like forms filled with text such as "markets" and "accounts." The scene conveys a sense of strength and leadership in tumultuous conditions.

artworks.title: Je ne pourrai jamais laver tout ça
artworks.description: The image depicts a large figure holding brushes standing next to a swirling mass labeled "Menagerie". The figure appears to be engaged in an act of cleaning or painting, as indicated by the brushes in its hands. The scene is drawn in a satirical style, with exaggerated features of the figure. The background shows an abstracted structure. The swirling mass on the right is chaotic, with lines suggesting movement and depth.

artworks.title: Voyons, monsieur Réac...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing in front of a field of crosses. One figure is labelled "PARIS" above the head. Both figures are gesturing towards the field of crosses. The background is sketched with minimal detail.

artworks.title: A Paris nous ne pouvions... aller a Versailles...
artworks.description: Three soldiers are depicted in the image. They stand in a row facing to the right, holding rifles upright with both hands. The front soldier's face is visible in profile. The soldiers have exaggerated facial features, including prominent noses and mustaches. They wear uniform hats, jackets, pants, and boots, and carry round backpacks. The background shows a flat, minimally detailed landscape, possibly near water, with shadows cast on the ground where the soldiers stand.

artworks.title: Successeur de Charlemagne
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure sitting on a throne surrounded by clocks. The central figure is depicted with a regal presence, wearing a crown and a robe, and is holding a staff in one hand and a clock in the other. The throne and platform are adorned with numerous clocks, each displaying different times. The drawing suggests themes of authority and the passage of time. The detailed line work emphasizes the figure's ornate attire and the intricacy of the clocks, creating a satirical and thought-provoking scene.

artworks.title: Versailles!... Trois semaines d'arrêt!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an old train and tracks with figures seeming to halt a railway line. The drawing depicts an industrial scene where a train labeled "POSTE DE PARIS" is approaching in the background, and two figures labeled "VERSAILLES" are grasping the train tracks. The illustration uses strong lines and shading to highlight the tension and movement. The composition shows a contrast between the figures and the incoming train, emphasizing the power dynamics and drama in the scene.
